name: system-school
description: Set up secure OAuth account linking to the existing school system and read permitted account data when the runtime supplies a secure OAuth access-token binding.

interface.shortDescription: راهنمای اتصال امن حساب مدرسه با OAuth
interface.longDescription: Integration setup and read-only HTTPS helper for the existing school system. Upload acceptance and platform OAuth token injection require separate verification. This package does not provide an MCP server or register a platform app.
defaultPrompt: اتصال امن حساب مدرسه را راه‌اندازی کن.
پس از اتصال معتبر، کلاس‌های مجاز حساب من را نمایش بده.
